<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#020617; --sky-50:#f0f9ff; --gray-50:#f9fafb; --gray-200:#e5e7eb;
    --accent:#38bdf8; --text:#0f172a; --text-soft:#475569;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{font-family:'Inter',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--text); line-height:1.55; margin:0;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; margin:0;}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}
  .eyebrow{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:12px; display:block;}
  section{padding:88px 0;}
  .pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; padding:14px 28px; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; text-decoration:none; border:2px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s ease;}
  .pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .pill-primary{background:var(--accent); color:var(--navy);}
  .pill-outline{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); color:#fff;}
  .pill-dark{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}

  .site-header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40; background:rgba(255,255,255,.95); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .site-header .wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 24px;}
  .brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text); line-height:1.1;}
  .brand .word{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-weight:700; font-size:19px;}
  .brand .word span{color:var(--accent);}
  .brand .tagline{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-soft); font-weight:500;}
  nav{display:flex; gap:28px; align-items:center;}
  nav a{color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; font-weight:500;}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--accent);}
  .header-cta{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;}
  .phone-link{font-weight:600; color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none; background:none; border:0; padding:6px; font-size:22px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text);}
  .header-cta .pill{white-space:nowrap;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    nav{display:none;}
    .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;}
    .site-header.nav-open nav{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; position:absolute; top:100%; left:0; right:0; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200); padding:18px 24px;}
  }

  .hero{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; padding:96px 0 72px;}
  .hero .badge{display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-radius:999px; padding:8px 16px; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:24px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:48px; color:#fff; max-width:820px;}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero p.lead{max-width:660px; font-size:17px; color:#cbd5e1; margin:22px 0 32px;}
  .hero .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .trust-row{display:flex; gap:32px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); padding-top:26px;}
  .trust-row div{font-size:14px; color:#e2e8f0; font-weight:500;}

  .bg-sky{background:var(--sky-50);}
  .bg-white{background:#fff;}
  .bg-gray{background:var(--gray-50); border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .bg-navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .bg-accent{background:var(--accent);}

  .section-head{max-width:680px; margin-bottom:48px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:32px;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--text-soft); margin-top:14px; font-size:15.5px;}
  .bg-navy .section-head p{color:#cbd5e1;}

  .grid{display:grid; gap:24px;}
  .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .grid-2,.grid-3,.grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .feature{padding:4px;}
  .feature .icon{font-size:28px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .feature h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .feature p{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:0;}

  .area-chip{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:12px; padding:16px; text-align:center; font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;}

  .check-list{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; display:grid; gap:14px;}
  .check-list li{display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text-soft);}
  .check-list li b{color:var(--text); font-weight:600;}
  .check-list li::before{content:"✓"; color:var(--accent); font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0;}
  .bg-navy .check-list li{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .bg-navy .check-list li b{color:#fff;}

  details.faq{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:12px; padding:18px 22px; margin-bottom:12px;}
  details.faq summary{font-weight:600; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none;}
  details.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  details.faq summary::after{content:"+"; float:right; font-size:20px; color:var(--accent);}
  details.faq[open] summary::after{content:"-";}
  details.faq p, details.faq ul{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:14px 0 0;}
  details.faq ul{padding-left:20px;}

  .cta-banner{text-align:center;}
  .cta-banner h2{font-size:32px; max-width:700px; margin:0 auto;}
  .cta-banner p{margin:14px 0 28px; font-size:15.5px;}
  .cta-banner .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  footer{padding:48px 0; background:var(--navy); color:#cbd5e1;}
  footer p{color:#94a3b8; font-size:14px; margin:0;}
  .footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); padding-top:20px; margin-top:24px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; font-size:13px; color:#94a3b8;}
  footer a{color:#cbd5e1; text-decoration:none;}
  .topbar{background:var(--navy);}
  .topbar-inner{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:7px 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:13px;}
  .open-status{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-weight:600; color:#fff;}
  .os-dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#4ade80; flex:none;}
  .open-status.is-open .os-dot{animation:ospulse 1.5s ease-out infinite;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-dot{background:#94a3b8;}
  .os-text{font-weight:700; color:#4ade80;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-text{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .os-sep{color:#64748b;}
  .os-clock{color:var(--accent); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;}
  @keyframes ospulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.7);} 70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,0);} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0);}}
</style>
bodyHtml:
🖥️ Emergency On-Site Server Repair For Business · Gold Coast & Surrounds

Server Support & Maintenance Gold Coast. Local, Fast, Business-Focused.

When a production server crashes, every minute hits productivity, revenue and client confidence. Computers Gold Coast sends certified engineers directly to your premises, Gold Coast, its hinterland, or northern NSW border towns, to diagnose, repair and protect Windows Server, Linux, VMware ESXi and Hyper-V hosts running your critical line-of-business applications or file shares.

Sort Out My Server
✓ One-Hour Call-Back
✓ Multi-Vendor Expertise
✓ Data-Safe Workflow
✓ Mobile Spares Kit
Why It Matters

Every Minute Of Server Downtime Costs You.

Staff sit idle while files and printers are offline, unclean shutdowns damage payroll or inventory data, and after-hours call-outs cost triple the daytime rate. Missed orders and late invoices hurt your reputation with clients who don't care why the system is down, only that it is.

Our Approach

One Team For Hardware, OS & Virtualisation.

A real ETA within 60 minutes, no call-centre run-around. We fix Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant, Lenovo ThinkSystem and Synology NAS hardware, plus Windows Server and VMware ESXi issues, in one visit, with an image-level backup or snapshot taken before any invasive work to protect SQL, MYOB, Xero or EPOS data.

What's Included

Why Business Clients Call Us First.

📞

One-Hour Call-Back & Rapid Dispatch

A real ETA within 60 minutes, not a call-centre run-around.

🧰

Multi-Vendor Expertise

Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant, Lenovo ThinkSystem, Synology NAS, Windows Server and VMware ESXi, all handled in one visit.

🚐

Mobile Spares Kit

Common RAID drives, PSUs, fans, NICs and memory on the van, so repairs happen same-day instead of waiting on freight.

💾

Data-First Workflow

Image-level backup or snapshot before invasive work, protecting SQL, MYOB, Xero or EPOS data.

🔄

Temporary Work-Arounds

A loan NAS or micro-hypervisor keeps payroll, email or point-of-sale online while parts arrive.

📋

Root-Cause & Prevention Report

A written summary with next-step recommendations after every incident, not just a fixed server.

Typical Faults We Repair Onsite

Hardware, OS And Virtualisation Faults We See Most.

  • Dead PSU or fan modules, replaced from the mobile spares kit where possible.
  • RAID rebuilds & failed disks, using the latest firmware catalogue for your hardware.
  • Windows Server bluescreen or Linux kernel panic, diagnosed and resolved onsite.
  • Hyper-V / VMware VMs stuck or refusing to boot, restored without a full host rebuild where possible.
  • Corrupt Active Directory, DNS or DHCP services, rebuilt and re-synced.
  • Overheating chassis, dust removal, fan curve reset, thermal paste reseat.
  • Sudden slow I/O on SQL-based applications, throttled and stabilised while the cause is fixed.
Break/Fix Engagement

How Our Onsite Repair Process Works.

  • Phone triage, an engineer confirms symptoms and brings likely spares before leaving the workshop.
  • On-site diagnosis, hardware tests, log review, OS and hypervisor checks.
  • Data-safe action, a snapshot or image taken before any disk swaps or registry edits.
  • Repair or loaner, faulty parts replaced, or a temporary host spun up.
  • Post-fix verification, services start, users connect, backups resume.
  • Root-cause & prevention report, a written summary with next-step recommendations.
Sort Out My Server
Extras Business Owners Often Request

Beyond The Break/Fix Callout.

Once the fire's out, plenty of clients ask us to set up ongoing protection so it doesn't happen again.

⏱️

Rapid-Response SLA

Prepaid hours with a 2-hour arrival guarantee and a fixed monthly fee, ask for a quote for your business.

🖥️

Hot-Swap Spare Server

An inexpensive standby unit pre-configured for fail-over if the main server goes down.

🔧

Quarterly Preventive Tune-Up

Firmware, OS patches and disk SMART review on a regular schedule, see our preventative maintenance service.

🔌

Loan UPS & Power Audit

Verify clean power so crashes don't recur, see our UPS & surge protection service.

💽

Bare-Metal DR Image

A portable SSD image plus an encrypted cloud copy so you're always covered.

☁️

Cloud Fail-Over Plan

Replicate critical VMs to the cloud so staff can work remotely if the office server ever goes down.

🏢

Server-Room Health Audit

Cooling, dust, cable management and rack power balancing reviewed on the spot.

🔔

24×7 Remote Monitoring

Disk, temperature and UPS alerts emailed before failure, not after.

Get in touch and we'll talk through which of these makes sense for your setup, and give you a straight quote.

Related Services

Round Out Your Business's IT Resilience.

💼

Business IT Support

Need ongoing support beyond the server itself? Our business IT support covers the rest of your network and workstations.

🗄️

NAS & File Server Setup

Considering a smaller Synology or QNAP setup instead of a full server? See our NAS & file server setup.

📂

Data Backup & Transfer

Already got the server fixed? Lock in proper data backup & transfer so it doesn't happen again.

🔒

Computer & Network Security

Server hardening is only part of the picture, our computer & network security service covers the rest of the network.

Server Down Right Now?

Call for an engineer dispatched right now, a real ETA within 60 minutes, no call-centre run-around.

Sort Out My Server

Frequently Asked Questions

Server Support Questions, Answered.

What counts as a "critical server emergency" for your rapid-response service?

Any outage that stops payroll, point-of-sale, SQL Server databases, or mission-critical line-of-business apps. If staff can't log in or customers can't transact, that's an emergency, call us immediately.

How fast can you reach a Southport business?

Under our two-hour SLA, a certified engineer is usually at the door within 90 minutes, traffic and Gold Coast bridge crossings permitting.

Can you recover a failed RAID 5 array on a Dell PowerEdge with no recent backup?

Yes, our RAID recovery process includes hot-spare insertion, RAID-level consistency checks, and block-level cloning to minimise data loss.

Do you handle Hyper-V blue-screen loops?

Yes. We capture memory dumps, identify faulty driver issues, and restore virtual-machine uptime, often without a full host rebuild.

My Linux server won't boot after a kernel update, can you fix that?

Yes, GRUB rollback, initramfs regeneration and LVM checks get most Ubuntu Server or CentOS hosts back online within the same visit.

Active Directory database is corrupt. Can you do an authoritative restore?

Yes, using standard directory service recovery tools, we rebuild SYSVOL, re-sync DFS-R, and re-establish secure logins.

Can you supply a loan Synology NAS while waiting on warranty parts?

We keep pre-tested Synology and QNAP units ready. We can replicate your shared folders overnight, then reverse-sync once the main server is fixed.

We're in the Gold Coast hinterland, around Tamborine Mountain, do you still offer on-site response?

Yes, hinterland and regional South East Queensland is part of our coverage. Travel surcharges may apply, but we can often be onsite the same day.

Do you align repairs with the ASD Essential Eight baseline?

Yes, patch levels, application control, MFA and backup verification are mapped to Essential Eight maturity from the Australian Cyber Security Centre, so cyber-insurance renewals go smoothly.

Do you provide fixed-price quarterly firmware maintenance visits?

Yes, our quarterly server firmware maintenance bundle covers BIOS, RAID, BMC, NIC and drive firmware with rollback testing, and costs less than a single emergency call-out.

Don't Wait For A Full Outage.

Call Computers Gold Coast for emergency server repair, or ask about a rapid-response SLA for your business.

Sort Out My Server
